title: Import or start fresh
help: Bring your members, ranks, and attendance over from your old system, or start with an empty gym. You can import later from Settings too.
offNotice: Billing and member emails stay off after setup. Turn them on from Settings → Go-live once you are ready to switch over.
importHelp: Upload, check, and commit a CSV export. Setup finishes with the import once it is complete.
dryRunOnly: This was a dry run. Commit the import to finish with it.
invalidImport: Choose a finished, committed import from this gym.
running: The import is still running. Finish setup when it is complete.
unavailable: Imports are not available right now.
error: The request failed. Please try again.
changed: Setup changed elsewhere. Reload and try again.
partialImport: Some rows were saved before this import failed. Review the errors and correct the CSV, then choose Skip to keep existing records or Update one match to apply corrections. Run another dry run before committing the remaining rows.
finished: Setup is complete. Billing and member emails are off until you turn them on.
